note_on_method: Each venue page rests on three City of Irvine pages: the pickleball page that counts the courts, calls them lit and prices the reservable ones, the court regulations page that says how an open court is shared, and the park's own page that gives the address, the hours and the amenities. The US Census address geocoder supplies the county and the postcode. Where the City is silent, these pages record the silence; where the City and the Census disagree on a postcode, both values are stated.

slots.description:
Eight lit pickleball courts, the largest set in Irvine, in a community park of approximately 22 acres.

The count rests on two City records. The pickleball page reads "eight lit pickleball courts located at Mike Ward Community Park", and the park's own amenity list reads "8 Lighted Pickleball Courts".

The rest of the amenity list describes the company the courts keep: two lighted basketball courts, three lighted racquetball courts, a sand volleyball court, a fitness parcourse, an amphitheatre and three restrooms. Courts #3 and #4 are the reservable pair, priced at $17 an hour for residents and $19 for non-residents. The other six are first come, first served.
slots.getting_there:
20 Lake Road, Irvine, CA 92604. The US Census address geocoder matched the address at house-number level as "20 LAKE RD, IRVINE, CA, 92604", in Orange County and in the incorporated place Irvine city. The park's published phone number is 949-724-6900.

The City publishes nothing about parking at this park: no lot, no fee, no permit. There are three restrooms and two drinking fountains in the amenity list. Hours are 6 a.m. to 10 p.m., daily.
slots.what_to_expect:
Eight lit courts, open 6 a.m. to 10 p.m. daily. They run under two sets of rules at once.

Six are open courts, governed by the City's regulations: "Open courts are on a first-come, first-serve basis. Please use the waiting board where available." When others are waiting, doubles has 60 minutes and singles 30, warm-up included, and groups may not camp on a court.

Courts #3 and #4 can be booked online between 7 a.m. and noon and 4 and 10 p.m., in one- or two-hour blocks. When nobody has booked them they "can be used for drop-in play", and a drop-in player must "immediately vacate the court if a reservation holder arrives". Contract instructors teach lessons here, and City programmes take priority over all other use.

No surface, peak times or parking are stated.

slots.description:
Six lit pickleball courts in a community park of approximately 32 acres in the north-east of the city.

The count is stated twice by the City: "six lit pickleball courts located at Portola Springs Community Park" on its pickleball page, and "6 Lighted Pickleball Courts" in the park's own amenity list. Courts #5 and #6 are the reservable pair, at $17 an hour for residents and $19 for non-residents; the other four are first come, first served.

This is also the home of Irvine Team Pickleball, the City's league. The amenity list adds a community centre, three lighted tennis courts, two lighted softball fields, two lighted soccer fields, a concession building and two restrooms.
slots.getting_there:
900 Tomato Springs, Irvine. The City prints two postcodes for this address. The park's own page gives "Irvine, CA 92620"; the City's pickleball page, giving the league address for these same courts, prints "Irvine, CA 92618", and so does the US Census address geocoder. The Census value, 92618, is published here, in Orange County and in the incorporated place Irvine city. The park's published phone number is 949-724-6192.

The City publishes nothing about parking at this park. There are two restrooms and four drinking fountains in the amenity list. Hours are 6 a.m. to 10 p.m., daily.
slots.what_to_expect:
Six lit courts, four open and two bookable, from 6 a.m. to 10 p.m. daily.

On the four open courts the City's regulations apply: first come, first served, the waiting board where there is one, doubles limited to 60 minutes and singles to 30 when others are waiting. Courts #5 and #6 can be reserved online between 7 a.m. and noon and 4 and 10 p.m., in one- or two-hour blocks, and revert to drop-in play whenever nobody has booked them.

Expect the league. Irvine Team Pickleball plays here: eight teams, a seven-week round robin and a three-week single-elimination playoff, self-rated at 3.5, at $490 per team per season. City sponsored programmes have priority over all other use, and contract instructors teach lessons here.

No surface, parking or peak times are stated.

slots.description:
Four lit pickleball courts in the largest of Irvine's three published parks, approximately 36.5 acres, with twelve lighted tennis courts alongside.

The City states the count twice: "four lit pickleball courts located at Heritage Park" on its pickleball page, and "4 Lighted Pickleball Courts" in the park's own amenity list. Its regulations page leaves Heritage out of its list of lit pickleball courts altogether, but the two records that do state a number agree.

Heritage is also one of the parks the City names for its hybrid tennis and pickleball courts. Those are not added here, because the City gives only a city-wide figure for them, ten on one page and nine on another, and never says how many are at Heritage. The park also has a community centre, a lake and a splash pad, and the City is developing a master plan for it.
slots.getting_there:
14301 Yale Ave., Irvine, CA 92604. The US Census address geocoder matched "14301 YALE AVE, IRVINE, CA, 92604" at house-number level, in Orange County, in the incorporated place Irvine city. The park's published phone number is 949-724-6750.

The City publishes nothing about parking here. There are four restrooms and eight drinking fountains in the amenity list. Hours are 6 a.m. to 10 p.m., daily.
slots.what_to_expect:
Four lit courts, all of them open courts, from 6 a.m. to 10 p.m. daily. Nothing at Heritage can be reserved: the City's online booking covers only two courts at Mike Ward and two at Portola Springs.

The City's regulations manage the queue: first come, first served, the waiting board where available, and doubles limited to 60 minutes and singles to 30 when others are waiting.

The City names Heritage among the parks with hybrid courts "where players may choose to play tennis or pickleball", and on tennis courts the rule is explicit: "Tennis courts are designated solely for tennis use", and pickleball players must vacate when tennis players arrive. The four dedicated courts carry no such condition.

No surface, parking or peak times are stated.

faqs.a: Four dedicated pickleball courts, stated twice: "four lit pickleball courts located at Heritage Park" and "4 Lighted Pickleball Courts".
No. The City's online booking covers two courts at Mike Ward and two at Portola Springs only. Every court at Heritage is first come, first served.

In addition, there are 10 hybrid tennis and pickleball courts located at the following parks: Heritage, Knollcrest, Los Olivos, Portola Springs, San Carlo, Turtle Rock, and University." "Pickleball court reservations are now available at Portola Springs Community Park (Courts #5 and #6) and Mike Ward Community Park (Courts #3 and #4). Residents may book up to five days in advance, while non-residents may book three days in advance." "Resident Rate: $17/hr", "Non-Resident Rate: $19/hr". "Reservations can be made in one or two hour increments, with individuals allowed to have one reservation per day." "Courts can be reserved Monday through Sunday, between the hours of 7 a.m. to noon, and 4 to 10 p.m." The reservable courts "can be used for drop-in play if there is no reservation or if a reservation no-shows. Please immediately vacate the court if a reservation holder arrives during their allotted time." Lessons "at Mike Ward Community Park, Portola Springs Community Park and Heritage Park". Irvine Team Pickleball at "Portola Springs Community Park - Pickleball Courts", "Address: 900 Tomato Springs, Irvine, CA 92618": "Eight teams face off in a 7-week Round Robin and a 3-week single-elimination playoffs. Match format is 3 men's doubles, 3 women's doubles, and 3 mixed doubles games to 11, win-by-1." "a self-rated level 3.5 league", "Maximum of 8 people per team", "Cost is $490 per team per season."
